The drop

The coaster from the reel.

A house, a pool, and the words “This is My Happy Place.” It started as a test cut. People kept asking about it. So it’s Drop 001. Engraved to order. No two age quite the same way.

  • MaterialNatural black slate, 4″ round or square. Rough, chipped edges. Every piece is a little different.
  • EngravingLaser-etched into the stone, not printed. Sealed after engraving with a matte clear coat.
  • DesignFeatured design, one of four styles, or your own text. Custom artwork is the $58 tier.
  • In the packPack of 6 coasters, numbered in the order they sell. Felt pads on the back.
  • ShippingEngraved and shipped within 24 hours, except around major holidays. Care card in every box: hand wash, no dishwasher.

Made in the garage

Cut, engraved, sealed. By hand.

No factory. No warehouse. Every coaster runs through the laser in a garage in Richardson, Texas. Packed the same day it’s engraved.

01 · Set

Set on the bed

Each slate gets wiped, jigged flat, lined up on the laser bed. Six at a time. One pack per run.

02 · Engrave

Etched, not printed

The laser etches the design into the stone itself. No ink, no vinyl. Nothing to fade, peel, or wash off.

03 · Seal & number

Sealed and numbered

Matte sealer goes on after engraving. The pack gets its number. Boxed for shipping within 24 hours.

One product. One small batch. Then it’s gone.
